//! Syntax preservation and conservative transformation boundaries.
#![cfg_attr(any(), forbid(unsafe_code), warn(missing_docs))]
#![deny(dead_code, reason = "not unsafe_code, missing_docs")]

use crate::leaf::fallible;

/// An explicit standard contract, with comments inside an unwrap suffix.
pub fn explicit() -> ::core::result::Result<u32, ::std::num::ParseIntError> {
    if false { return "2".parse(); }
    let _value = fallible(). /* keep */ unwrap(/* also keep */);
    "3".parse()
}

fn branches(value: bool) -> u32 {
    if value { return 1; }
    match value { true => { 2 }, false => 3 }
}

fn unit(value: bool) {
    if value { return; }
    if value { return; }
}

fn terminal(value: bool) -> u32 {
    if value { return 1; } else { return 2; };
}

fn handling() {
    let _ = fallible().unwrap_or(4);
    let _ = fallible().unwrap_or_default();
    let _ = fallible().is_ok();
    let _ = fallible().is_err();
    let _ = (fallible()).unwrap();
}

fn residual() -> crate::leaf::ReadResult<u32> { fallible()?; fallible() }

fn nested_methods() {
    fallible().one(fallible().two()).three();
    (fallible().one())?;
}

fn labeled() -> u32 { 'exit: { break 'exit 1; } }

fn scopes() {
    let _closure = || { return 1; };
    let _future = async { return 2; };
    let _constant = const { 3 };
    fn local() { return; }
    local();
}

fn loops() {
    for _ in 0..2 { if false { return; } }
    while false { return; }
    loop { break; }
}

fn generic<T>() -> T where T: Default { T::default() }
fn lifetime<'a>(value: &'a str) -> &'a str { value }
pub unsafe extern "C" fn foreign() {}
const fn constant() -> u32 { 4 }
async fn future() -> u32 { 5 }
fn diverge() -> ! { loop {} }
fn generated() -> ::core::result::Result<u32, ::core::convert::Infallible> { Ok(6) }
fn main() {}

#[cfg(any())]
fn inactive() -> u32 { 7 }

mod inline {
    pub struct Widget;
    pub fn nested() -> u32 { 8 }
}

fn macro_boundary() { todo!("opaque return"); }

/// Attribute inventory preserves docs without reparsing their spelling.
#[cfg_attr(not(kani), tracing::instrument(level = "debug", skip(value), fields(note = "keep : : spaces")))]
fn attributed(value: u32) { #![allow(unused)] let _ = value; }

#[derive(Debug)]
struct AttributeOwner<'a, T, const N: usize>(&'a T);
trait AttributeTrait { fn method(&self); }
impl<'a, T, const N: usize> AttributeTrait for AttributeOwner<'a, T, N> {
    /// A method on a generic trait implementation.
    #[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
    fn method(&self) {}
}
impl<'a> AttributeOwner<'a, (&'a mut u32, [u8; 0x10]), 4> {
    #[instrument(level = "trace")]
    fn tuple_method(&self) {}
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod excluded_attributes {
    #[instrument] fn excluded() {}
}
#[cfg(any())]
mod inactive_attributes {
    #[cfg_attr(not(kani), instrument)] fn nested() {}
}
#[cfg(any())]
mod external_attributes;
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
fn exported_attribute() {}

struct TraceRole;
impl TraceRole {
    fn new() -> Self { Self }
    fn get_value(&self) -> u32 { 1 }
    fn set_value(mut self, value: u32) { let _ = value; }
    fn is_ready(&self) -> bool { true }
    pub(in crate::inline) fn scoped(&self) {}
}
fn bindings<T>((value, count): (T, u32), slice: &[u8], callback: fn()) {
    let _ = (value, count, slice, callback);
}
